{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Confections|Confections]] | [[Cookbook:Fudge|Fudge]]

'''Chocolate fudge''' is a traditional, rich [[Cookbook:Confections|candy]], especially around the holidays in the [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|United States]].

==Ingredients==

* 2 ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] (550 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] / 1.2 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]]) white granulated [[cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* ½ cup (125 g / 4.4 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) [[cookbook:Margarine|margarine]] or [[cookbook:butter|butter]]
* ⅔ cup (160 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] / 5.4 oz) [[cookbook:Evaporated milk|evaporated milk]]
* 1 jar (7 oz / 200 g) [[Cookbook:Marshmallow Creme|marshmallow creme]]
* 2 cups (160 g / 5.6 oz) semi sweet [[cookbook:chocolate chips|chocolate chips]]
* ¾ cup (75 g / 2.6 oz) chopped [[cookbook:walnuts|walnuts]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]]

==Procedure==

# Line a {{convert|9|in|cm|adj=on}} square or {{convert|13|by|9|in|cm|adj=on}} pan with [[Cookbook:Aluminium Foil|foil]] so that foil extends over sides of pan; butter foil.
#In large [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]], combine sugar, margarine, and evaporated milk. Bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] over medium heat, stirring constantly.
# After 5 minutes of constant stirring, remove saucepan from heat.
# Add marshmallow creme and chocolate chips; blend until smooth. Stir in walnuts and vanilla.
# Pour into buttered, foil-lined pan. Cool to room temperature.
# Score fudge into 36–48 squares. Refrigerate until firm.
# Remove fudge from pan by lifting foil; remove foil from sides of fudge. Using large knife, cut through scored lines. Store in refrigerator.
